newsitem.title: UK: Bradys simmer, wait for U.S. Fed to turn up heat.
newsitem.headline: Bradys simmer, wait for U.S. Fed to turn up heat.

text.p: Emerging debt languished on Tuesday, waiting for what many consider the inevitable announcement of a some increase in U.S. interest rates today.
"People are just squaring up for this afternoon. There may be a small rally if (the U.S. interest) rates rise by 25 points," a European bank trader said.
He said potential upside after the jump on Monday in U.S. shares failed to spill over into Bradys.
Traders say the question, as in most other markets, is now how much further U.S. rates are seen likely to rise.
"I wouldn't be surprised if the market goes up in the very short-term on a sense of relief," said Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Stuart Parkinson.
But after that it will depend very much on the economic data coming out of the U.S. and whether that points to further rate hikes, he added.
